title: Lateen performance comparison
description: What changed in gzip bytes between two commits' asset manifests: per route the CSS, JavaScript, font, and total deltas, every changed asset by path, and the problems that fail the gate. A positive delta is growth. Lists are ordered by route and asset path; no wall-clock time is recorded, so the same two manifests write the same file.

base.description: The commit the base manifest was built from.

head.description: The commit the head manifest was built from.

tolerance.description: The gzip growth an existing asset may show before the gate fails, in bytes.

css.description: Gzip delta across css/base and css/page.

javascript.description: Gzip delta across js/chrome, js/components, and js/inline.

assets.description: The assets whose gzip size changed, sorted by path. An absent side was not loaded by that commit.

problems.description: Every reason the comparison fails: a route on one side only, a duplicate path, a new asset, or growth past the tolerance.
